title: Ruth
subtitle: The story of a friend who wouldn’t let go, a field full of barley, and a kindness that changed everything

scenes.title: Where You Go, I Will Go
beats: Long ago, a woman named Naomi lived far from home, in the land of Moab, with her husband and her two grown-up sons.
But sad days came. Naomi’s husband died, and then both of her sons died too. All she had left were her sons’ wives, Orpah and Ruth.
Naomi decided to go back home to Bethlehem. “Go home to your mothers,” she told the young women. Orpah kissed her goodbye and went. But Ruth held on tight.
“Wherever you go, I will go,” Ruth said. “Your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.”

scenes.title: Gleaning in the Field
beats: Naomi and Ruth walked all the way to Bethlehem. They got there just as the barley harvest was beginning.
They had no food, so Ruth went to the fields to glean. That means she walked behind the workers and picked up the grain they dropped.
The field belonged to a kind man named Boaz. “Stay in my field,” he told Ruth, “and drink from our water jars whenever you’re thirsty.”
“Why are you so kind to me?” asked Ruth. “I heard how you took care of Naomi,” said Boaz. “May God, who keeps you safe under His wings, bless you.”

touch.hint: Tap to help Ruth gather grain

scenes.title: Handfuls on Purpose
beats: At lunchtime, Boaz shared his bread with Ruth. She ate until she was full, and she even saved some for Naomi.
Then Boaz told his workers a secret: “Pull out some barley and drop it on purpose, so Ruth can pick it up!”
That evening, Ruth carried home a big, heavy bundle of grain. Naomi’s eyes grew wide. “Who was so kind to you?”
“His name is Boaz,” said Ruth. “Boaz!” said Naomi. “He’s part of our family! God hasn’t stopped being kind to us after all.”

layers.hint: Tap to take the grain home

scenes.title: A Promise at the Gate
beats: Naomi had an idea. Ruth went to Boaz and asked him to take care of their family, because he was their family’s redeemer: a relative who helps when things go wrong.
Boaz said yes! The very next morning he went to the city gate, where the town leaders sat, to make it official.
A man pulled off his sandal and handed it to Boaz. Back then, that’s how people shook hands on a promise! Everyone cheered: “We saw it! We are witnesses!”

scenes.title: A Baby Named Obed
beats: So Boaz and Ruth got married, and God gave them a baby boy. They named him Obed.
Naomi held little Obed on her lap and laughed for joy. She had come home sad and empty, but now her heart was full again.
And guess what? When Obed grew up, he had a son named Jesse. And Jesse had a son named David, who became a great king!

questions: Ruth could have gone back home, but she stayed with Naomi. Why do you think she did?
Boaz dropped barley on purpose so Ruth could find it. What are some quiet ways we can be kind?
Who is someone you can stick with and help, like Ruth did?

verse.text: For wherever you go, I will go, and wherever you live, I will live; your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.
